articles.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
articles.description: As high as 50%, Canada's levies will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.

articles.title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
articles.description: Air raid alerts and sounds of explosions rang out in Ukraine's capital as Russian forces launched drone strikes early on Tuesday.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
articles.description: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.

articles.title: Kenya moves to register frightened Burundians as tension over foreign traders rises
articles.description: All foreigners without proper documents in Kenya are urged to  register through their embassies.

articles.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
articles.description: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.

articles.title: Trump threatens to halt sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US - as trade war intensifies
articles.description: Donald Trump has warned Canadian aircraft company Bombardier that it will be no longer be permitted to sell its planes in the US unless it moves its manufacturing to the country.

articles.title: EU to invest £171m in Greenland amid Trump tensions
articles.description: The EU is to invest €200m (£171m) in Greenland to improve relations with the Arctic island amid tensions caused by Donald Trump's demands that the territory be handed over to the US.
